captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a two-part parametric luggage tag: a solid base plate and a matching top frame. The base plate features an integrated loop on one end for a strap, a recessed rectangular slot to hold a card, and a decorative open-source hardware gear logo cut into its center. The top frame has a large rectangular window to keep the card visible, and both parts feature matching rounded corners with four screw holes for secure assembly.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, two-part luggage tag in OpenSCAD consisting of a base plate and a windowed top cover that clamp together. The model must allow customization of the card dimensions (width, length, thickness), margin thickness, screw hole diameters for assembly, and include an optional decorative logo cut into the base plate.
captions.factory: The code defines 'base' and 'top' modules that are combined in a 'plate' layout. Both parts are built by unioning intersecting cubes and cylinders at the corners to form rounded rectangles. The 'base' module subtracts a pocket for the card, four corner screw holes with hex nut recesses, and a 2D open-source hardware gear logo extruded using linear_extrude. The 'top' module subtracts a large central window and recessed screw holes for cap heads.
